basis: Bone fragility and low bone density define OI14; blue sclerae do not impair vision; hearing loss occurs in 2/8, below threshold.
Malignant epithelial tumour originating in salivary glands, which belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Adenoma originating in the parathyroid gland; additional organ damage is not established for this histologic subtype.
Lacrimal, hearing and dental/salivary abnormalities define LADD; skeletal digital malformations occur in 11/14 (~79%), completing the four-axis cap.
ITPA-related purine metabolic encephalopathy; cataracts occur in 3/7 (~43%). Cardiomyopathy is occasional (5-29%), below threshold.
Fibrosis confined to breast parenchyma; breast has no axis.
Distal tubular acidification failure causes acidosis and hypokalemia; sensorineural hearing loss occurs in 9/23 (~39%). Rickets occurs in 2/9, below threshold.
Inherited phospholipid metabolic disorder causing spinal and motor axonal degeneration; muscle wasting reflects denervation rather than intrinsic muscle disease.
The syndrome is defined by hereditary ataxia and congenital glaucoma; additional features of ordinary Friedreich ataxia cannot be assumed.
White-matter degeneration defines disease; ovarian endocrine failure is reported in 2/2 and cataract in 1/1. Frequencies derive from very small samples.
Cone-rod retinal degeneration defines disease; supplied hearing, endocrine and cognitive findings lack frequencies supporting involvement in at least 30%.
Carcinoma originates in liver; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine disease. Cardiac and neurologic complications are below 30%.
Benign neoplasm of vascular channels; anatomical sites vary across the umbrella, so no additional site-specific axis applies generally.
Malignant tumour of olfactory neural epithelium arising in the sinonasal airway; both the defined location and olfactory neural origin apply.
Immune-mediated oligoarthritis; ANA positivity increases uveitis risk, but involvement is not reliably at least 30% across this subgroup.
Congenital neutropenic immunodeficiency with marrow fibrosis and renal hematopoietic infiltration; hepatic extramedullary hematopoiesis/hepatomegaly occurs in 7/7.
Umbrella defined by abnormal structure or function of skin or subcutaneous tissue; no other axis applies across the group.
Severe fetal circulatory and fluid-balance disorder; heterogeneous causes and fluid collections do not establish common intrinsic damage to additional organs.
Familial infantile epilepsy; ictal apnea and cyanosis do not establish intrinsic pulmonary or cardiovascular damage.
Malignancy of mature B lymphocytes; lymphoma requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis. No additional organ site defines this molecular subtype.
Carcinoma originating in the esophageal glands.
Myopia, skeletal abnormalities and sensorineural hearing loss define this Stickler subtype; intellectual disability is reported in 3/3 (100%).
Cerebellar developmental disease with ataxia, tremor and sometimes seizures; weakness and hypotonia do not establish intrinsic skeletal muscle disease.
Inherited renal amino acid transport defect with cystine stones and renal dysfunction; hypertension is a separately diagnosed secondary condition.
Hereditary bilirubin handling disorder causing conjugated hyperbilirubinemia; hepatic excretory dysfunction and metabolic abnormality define the condition.
